text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'll win them all--every single one!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll do it in my own way! Everything I do!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will do my absolute best without 
neglecting my health management.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmmm...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Craaash!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Bwehhh~!? The bell fell on meee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spent another lively New Year's together 
with Matikanetannhauser and her friends.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*sniff, sniff-sniff*... Yeah, it should be 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what a surprise~. I wonder if my 
wish got through properly?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Machitan, what did you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, you see, I'm finally entering the 
Senior Class this year, so I told them I 
want to aim even higher!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Especially this year, there are so many 
amazing girls. If you zone out for a 
second, any one of them could sweep the 
rug right out from under you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Macqueen-san, aiming for a 3-peat in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). Palmer-san, making 
waves across various GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Flower-san is also one to watch. 
Her performance in the sprint division was 
magnificent, after all."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I hear the girls slated to run on the 
Classic circuit this year are pretty 
incredible, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san, Ticket-san, and Taishin-san. 
Oh boy, this is something to look forward 
to.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Looking forward to it," huh. Same as 
always.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Tannhauser, do you 
have any goals for this year?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anything other than winning every single 
one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Umm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...I do, but it's embarrassing, so it's a 
secret.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in the evening of that day, she called 
out to stop me just as we were parting 
ways.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's something I only want to tell 
my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, regarding my goals... ...This year, 
I'd like to try finding myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! What the Chairwoman told me at summer 
training camp—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Saying things like "Because it's you"... I 
really, really just don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Only because it's you"...? What does that 
even mean?! It's just been bugging me so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I guess I don't really understand myself 
all that well, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live up to the Chairwoman's 
expectations, and to do that, I feel I 
need to understand!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, yep! This year, I'm also going on a 
'journey to find myself'!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's keep giving it our all! 
What should our very first task of the new 
year be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Speaking of training fit for today—
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, let's go for the full 
course!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? On the very first day!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Which means starting tomorrow, you'll be 
strict with me...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you're totally fired up...! In 
that case, I won't hesitate to conserve my 
energy today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right... Time for bed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snore*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the first training session of the 
new year began in a peaceful, harmonious 
atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The full course! You mean going back and 
forth between the track, the indoor gym, 
and the pool... !?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That looks fun! Which one should we do 
first? It's so hard to choose!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know, let's draw ghost legs! It'll 
be our first test of luck for the new 
year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the first training session of the 
new year began in a peaceful, harmonious 
atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...! Scouting out the competition!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Which means we grab tree branches and head 
to the grounds, right!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, hey, while we're at it, wanna dress 
up as ninjas too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the first training session of the 
new year began in a peaceful, harmonious 
atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Year is packed with formidable 
rivals. I need to fire myself up and 
sprint all the way through!
